note: v3743: Three now-ruled vault fixes (REG-2241/2242/2243). KEEPER CHARMS (his 2026-10-15 ruling torches and anni stay in shared, gheeds gets muled): Hellfire Torch and Annihilus now route to the SHARED stash and Gheeds Fortune falls through to its grand-charm mule, so the three iconic charms no longer all park on MAIN; the Hellfire Torch survival marker is kept so it is never pruned, and his per-item share switch can reach them. MERC GEAR: a MERC_GEAR rule in suggestMule routes mercenary-worn gear to SHARED (seeded with Guillaume Face, Andariel Visage, Mara Kaleidoscope plus five canonical merc uniques), after the keeper and share-override checks and before the category branch, respecting a forced mule override. SET-DUPE HARDENING: the copy-count fold is confirmed on disk before the once-per-world stamp; a failed copies write leaves the world unstamped and restores the removed strays so the next reload re-runs the migration. HEART: each fix ships a RED-first guard (three v3743 Routine-I spec.ts), and the v1814 base-routing spec is re-anchored so a slot-pair migration does not drag merc gear out to shared.
